title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded in San Francisco during Fourth of July celebrations when heavy traffic following fireworks prevented them from moving, causing their batteries to drain. At least a dozen vehicles required intervention, with some needing to be towed. This represents a failure of the system to handle an unusual but foreseeable traffic condition, where the vehicle's energy management could not account for extended stationary periods in gridlock.

The deployment did not appear equipped to handle the exceptional circumstances of a major public event with unexpected road closures and crowd-induced congestion. A system designed for normal traffic patterns was used in conditions it had not been built to manage. Human operators could have prevented stranding by manually removing vehicles from the area before batteries depleted, or by restricting operations during the event.

One vehicle also caught fire after driving over fireworks debris on the street, and passengers reported feeling unsafe as driverless cars continued operating amid dangerous conditions. Whether these incidents reflect inadequate operational planning, insufficient geofencing around hazards, or poor judgment about when to suspend service is not established.

summary:
# Summary

During Fourth of July celebrations in San Francisco on Saturday, several Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded when their batteries drained while stuck in heavy traffic following fireworks at the Golden Gate Bridge. Video footage showed at least a dozen stationary Waymo vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, lined up on streets, with some requiring towing. The company attributed the problem to major traffic disruptions, high volumes of travelers, and unexpected road closures that created severe congestion in the area.

The incident also included a vehicle that caught fire after driving over fireworks on the street, though no injuries were reported. Some passengers reported feeling unsafe when the driverless cars continued operating amid dangerous conditions caused by fireworks. Waymo stated it is evaluating ways to improve resilience during major traffic disruptions. Mayor Daniel Lurie's office indicated it will hold conversations with public and private partners to improve traffic management for similar future events.
